title: Stabilizers — Stabiliser Box — Extend the Upper Panel Stiffener Run and Replace the Rib 6 Splice Plate
abstract: Shop embodiment of the extended upper panel stiffener run and the thicker rib 6 splice plate on stabilisers already delivered, offered to operators embodying at a stabiliser overhaul.

sections.planning_reason: The full scale fatigue article showed strain redistribution at the upper panel splice ahead of the predicted life, with load turning into the panel skin two bays earlier than the substantiation assumed. Nothing has been found in service and the existing inspection covers the area, but one operator with a high cycle fleet asked for the production standard to be made available at its next stabiliser overhaul rather than carrying the inspection to the end of the design life.
sections.description: This bulletin extends the stiffener run on the upper panel outboard from rib four to rib nine, replaces the rib six splice plate with the thicker item and its two row fastener pattern, and deletes the obsolete outboard stringer, filling its holes with oversize interference fasteners. The rib attachments are unchanged and the box remains interchangeable between airframes after embodiment.
sections.accomplishment_summary: With the stabiliser removed and in the shop, remove the upper panel access provisions and the obsolete outboard stringer. Ream the vacated holes to the oversize dimension and install interference fasteners to the shop standard. Install the extended stiffener sections and the thicker splice plate, drilling the two row pattern at twenty-two millimetre pitch with the supplied jig and holding the edge distance stated. Do an eddy current inspection of the reworked fastener rows to SRM-M-55-10-11-003 and record the results. Apply the surface protection scheme, refit the access provisions and do the stabiliser box inspection in AMM-M-55-10-11-200-044-A before release.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00219 and M00428. Embodiment is only possible with the stabiliser removed; there is no on-wing accomplishment and no partial embodiment of the splice plate without the stiffener extension.
sections.material_note: Kit contains the stiffener sections, the splice plate, the interference fastener set and the drill jig on loan. Removed items are scrapped locally with a photographic record. Kit lead time is twenty-two weeks and the drill jig must be booked with the kit.

type_data.compliance_time: At a stabiliser overhaul, at the operator's convenience.

sections.accomplishment_summary: With the stabiliser removed and in the shop, check the aircraft against the exclusion list in the effectivity before any work starts. Remove the upper panel access provisions and the obsolete outboard stringer. Where the panel carries an interim splice repair, remove it and assess its holes to SRM-M-55-10-11-003 before continuing; a panel that cannot be cleared by that assessment goes to the individual route. Ream the vacated holes to the oversize dimension and install interference fasteners to the shop standard. Install the extended stiffener sections and the thicker splice plate, drilling the two row pattern at twenty-two millimetre pitch with the supplied jig and holding the edge distance stated. sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00219 and M00428, except MSN M00303 and MSN M00313. Those two aircraft carry an approved repair on the upper panel at the rib 6 splice, on the fastener rows this accomplishment reworks, and the standard drill jig and oversize scheme do not cover a panel that has already been repaired there. They are excluded from this Service Bulletin and are handled individually: the operator raises a repair approval request with the repair record and the shop findings, and a dedicated accomplishment is issued against the aircraft. Do not attempt to work either aircraft to this Service Bulletin and do not treat the exclusion as a deferral. Embodiment is only possible with the stabiliser removed; there is no on-wing accomplishment and no partial embodiment of the splice plate without the stiffener extension.
